source:
@@U04662@@
Beautiful, ravishing children, tell me, please, aren't you, too, kin to Great 路西法? You prettiest of the prettiest, how I long to kiss you! I think you're going to suit me very well! How at ease I am, so natural around you, as if [d seen you a thousand times over. The more I look, the lovelier you become, and I more like a common rutting alley cat! Come to me, come! Come, just one look at you! Only one!

@@U04664@@
We're coming! You see? Why shrink away so? Closer, closer. Stay if you can stand it.

@@U04665@@
(The ANGELS hovering about take up the entire stage.)

@@U04667@@
(Pushed forward into the proscenium.)

@@U04668@@
You call us spirits of the damned, but what about you? You're the real witch masters, seducing men and women both! Ah, what a blasted affair! Love? Can this be it? The stuff of love? My body’s so on fire, I almost feel no burning pain in my neck! You sway, you sashay, this way, that way. Come down, why don’t you, come, and move those lovely limbs a bit more profanely! Oh, I know, I know, this serious air becomes you,
translation:
@@U04662@@
美丽迷人的孩子们，请告诉我，你们不也是大路西法的亲戚吗？你是最美丽的人，我多么渴望亲吻你！我想你会非常适合我！我是多么自在，在你身边如此自然，仿佛见过你一千次。越看越可爱，我更像一只发情的野猫了！到我这里来，来吧！来来来，就看你一眼！只有一个！

@@U04664@@
我们来了！你看？为何如此退缩？更近了，更近了。如果你能忍受的话就留下来吧。

@@U04665@@
（盘旋的天使占据了整个舞台。）

@@U04667@@
（被推到台口上。）

@@U04668@@
你称我们为受诅咒的灵魂，但你呢？你们才是真正的巫师，诱惑男人女人！啊，多么该死的事情啊！爱？可以这样吗？爱情的东西？我的身体如此火热，我的脖子几乎感觉不到火辣辣的疼痛！你摇摆，你潇洒，这边，那边。下来吧，你为什么不来，把那些可爱的四肢活动得更亵渎一点呢！哦，我知道，我知道，这严肃的气氛就是你，
